title: Commercial Arithmetic: Interest, Discount, Commission and VAT
seo_title: Commercial Arithmetic – JSS 2 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Solve problems on simple interest, discount, commission, VAT and hire purchase. (summary of the NERDC JSS 2 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 2 maths worksheets on commercial arithmetic in naira: simple interest, discount, commission, VAT at 7.5% and hire purchase. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Simple interest I = P × R × T ÷ 100. Amount = P + I.
  • Discount and commission are percentages of a price or of sales.
  • VAT (Value Added Tax) is 7.5% of the price. Hire purchase: deposit + instalments.

Examples

Example

Interest on ₦80,000 at 6% for 2 years

80,000 × 6 × 2 ÷ 100

Answer: ₦9,600

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Using months as yearsChange months to years: 6 months = ½ year.
Forgetting the depositInclude it in the total.
Subtracting VATVAT is added to the price.
